summary: Master the fundamentals of FinTech with our training course. Gain essential skills and knowledge to navigate the future of financial technology effectively.
lede: AML foundations for FinTech cover how digital financial services identify and manage financial-crime risks. For professionals who evaluate, build, operate, or control digital payments and lending, the course develops practical skills in designing customer due diligence workflows, interpreting transaction-monitoring alerts, and connecting fraud controls with product and operational risks. Learners also practice mapping payment journeys, assessing technology risks, and turning findings into an implementation plan.
audienceIntro: This FinTech training is designed for professionals who evaluate, build, operate, control, or communicate digital financial services. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a shared vocabulary and practical decision tools without requiring software development experience.
prerequisites: No programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with financial services, business processes, or technology-enabled operations. Helpful preparation includes bringing a non-confidential example of a digital payment, lending, wallet, insurance, or banking process from your organization. Advanced subjects such as AI-assisted underwriting, distributed ledger technology, and cloud architecture receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production-engineering treatment.
